overall_notes: Paper focuses on social norm generation and explainable textual entailment tasks. Uses human-AI collaboration framework with GPT-3 for data generation and smaller models (T5 variants) for evaluation. Well-documented human evaluation with substantial inter-annotator agreement. Automatic metrics include BLEURT and BERTScore for explanation quality.
